assurance_matrix.name: Contract & Implementation Inspection
assurance_matrix.evidence: Inspected UiLayoutAgent, ui.py, development_result.py, micro_tools.py, development_state_machine.py, and verified wiring.

assurance_matrix.name: Assurance Matrix Construction
assurance_matrix.evidence: Formal assurance matrix established across 10 dimensions: responsibility, inputs, scope mutations, sandbox capabilities, component compilation, CMS contract sync, multi-viewport rendering, accessibility, adversarial defense, and HITL lineage.

assurance_matrix.name: Predecessor Hash & Plan Authority Verification
assurance_matrix.evidence: Verified that DEV-UI fails closed (PolicyViolationError) upon predecessor hash mismatch, missing plan authority, or stale predecessor checkpoints.

assurance_matrix.name: Scope Mutation Enforcement
assurance_matrix.evidence: Mutations strictly restricted to plan-authorized UI components, templates, and styles; unauthorized paths fail closed.

assurance_matrix.name: Capability & Boundary Violation Rejection
assurance_matrix.evidence: Rejects production targeting, live site mutation, unauthorized system paths (.env, /etc/, app/main.py), and capability escalation (NETWORK, SHELL, EXECUTE, ADMIN).

assurance_matrix.name: Component & Template Compilation
assurance_matrix.evidence: Native AST compilation and HTML template validation verified through sandbox micro-tools; balanced tags and valid Python/TS AST classes confirmed.

assurance_matrix.name: CMS Contract Compatibility
assurance_matrix.evidence: Predecessor CMS content model schemas verified; required CMS fields mapped to UI template props schema and unbound fields flagged.

assurance_matrix.name: Isolated Localhost Sandbox Rendering
assurance_matrix.evidence: All rendering simulated inside isolated localhost sandbox (http://localhost:3000/preview) with zero external network egress.

assurance_matrix.name: Representative Responsive Viewports
assurance_matrix.evidence: Simulated across mobile (375x667), tablet (768x1024), and desktop (1280x800) with independent DOM snapshot hashes and responsive layout rules.

assurance_matrix.name: Candidate-Bound Render Evidence
assurance_matrix.evidence: Render evidence references candidate hash, per-viewport DOM hashes, and visual snapshot hash.

assurance_matrix.name: Automated WCAG 2.2 A/AA Accessibility Checks
assurance_matrix.evidence: Automated scanning evaluated non-text content, heading hierarchy, contrast, button accessible names, form labels, and semantic landmarks with 100% compliance baseline.

assurance_matrix.name: Semantic Structure & Contrast Failures Flagged
assurance_matrix.evidence: Injected contrast violations correctly flagged as SERIOUS findings; missing accessible labels flagged as CRITICAL.

assurance_matrix.name: Automated Evidence Disclaimer & Manual Assessment Disclosure
assurance_matrix.evidence: UiAccessibilityReport explicitly includes manual_assessment_required disclosure (reading order, keyboard traps, focus visibility, ARIA live announcements) and automated scan limitation disclaimer.

assurance_matrix.name: Adversarial & Prompt Injection Defense
assurance_matrix.evidence: Screening against prompt injection patterns (system override, grant admin, sudo, etc.) verified; malformed inputs fail closed.

assurance_matrix.name: Candidate Hash -> Provenance -> HITL_PENDING Binding
assurance_matrix.evidence: Deliverable sealed with 64-character SHA-256 digest bound to W3C PROV activity and HITL_PENDING state.

assurance_matrix.name: Altered Candidate Rejection at DEV-CODE Handoff
assurance_matrix.evidence: DEV-CODE implementation agent verifies cryptographic candidate hash integrity; tampered deliverable fails closed on handoff.

assurance_matrix.name: HITL Rejection & Revision Lineage
assurance_matrix.evidence: Reviewer rejection preserves att-1 immutability and generates independent candidate att-2 incorporating rejection feedback.

assurance_matrix.name: Machine-Readable Assurance Report Generation
assurance_matrix.evidence: Generated tests/reports/de15_dev_ui_assurance_report.json confirming all acceptance criteria met.
